heroHeadline: Rubio Says Iran 'Opening Up' on Nuclear Issue — Khamenei More Active as US Insists on Concrete Concessions for Sanctions Relief
heroSubtitle: From Cyrus the Great's Achaemenid Empire (550 BCE) through the 1979 Islamic Revolution to the post-war Islamic Republic under Mojtaba Khamenei — now at its most critical juncture: Secretary Rubio reported June 2 that Iran is 'opening up' on the nuclear issue and that Khamenei appears 'more active' in ongoing talks, while the US reaffirmed it will only grant sanctions relief in direct exchange for concrete nuclear concessions — the MOU remains unsigned as the mid-June ceasefire expiry approaches.
